product_one_liner.value: WindBorne combines atmospheric observations from autonomous, long-duration weather balloons with AI models to deliver weather data, forecasts and actionable intelligence for governments and weather-sensitive businesses.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link in the public navigation/footer; the pricing URL did not return a page. Commercial API access is contact-led.

named_customers.notes: NOAA is explicitly described as an operational customer; the Air Force purchases atmospheric observations under a federal contract.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 103 employees; this is a profile estimate rather than an audited headcount.

eng_blog.notes: Technical posts include balloon-radio communications by Electrical Engineering Lead Sarah Brennan and WeatherMesh-4 architecture by Machine Learning Engineer Haoxing Du.

public_docs.notes: Public API documentation includes authentication, SDK/CLI, forecasts, model documentation and atmospheric observations.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live posting: Machine Learning Research Engineer, Model Evaluation.

model_provider.value: WindBorne’s proprietary WeatherMesh AI weather-model family, including WeatherMesh-6; MetaMesh blends WeatherMesh with other AI and numerical weather forecasts.

compliance_certs.notes: The public legal/privacy page names none of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR or PCI DSS as a certification.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 5, 2026 Series B falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live posting: Enterprise Account Executive — Utilities.

launched_6mo.notes: WeatherMesh-6 launched June 1, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026; the company’s August announcement also confirms its introduction two months earlier.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No unambiguous, dated C-suite or VP join/departure was established for November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026. The public leadership roster does not establish complete executive tenure history; unconventional “Chief” titles were not assumed to be C-level appointments.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The privacy policy explicitly confirms use of Google Analytics for the marketing website and PostHog for service analytics; the GTM posting also mentions PostHog. No specific CRM vendor was established. HotJar and Mixpanel appear only as examples of desired tool familiarity, so are not asserted as deployed systems.
